rows.cutoff_rationale: Retain all available earlier history. End on July 31, 2018 to exclude August near the extract boundary. Later delivered purchases extend to August 29; this buffer does not prove complete follow-up. Final status is retrospective, not a historical backtest.

repeat.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.repeat_summary ORDER BY window_days

cohorts.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.cohort_activity ORDER BY cohort_month,month_index

quality.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_payment) AS missing_payment_orders,count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_delivery_date) AS missing_delivery_dates,count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_approval_date) AS missing_approval_dates,count(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_mismatch) AS payment_mismatch_orders FROM analytics.orders

overview.sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers,sum(order_count) AS orders,sum(monetary_value) AS merchandise_value,count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_customer) AS repeat_customers,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_repeat_customer) AS one_time_customers,avg(order_count) AS purchases_per_customer,count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_customer)::numeric/nullif(count(*),0) AS observed_repeat_rate,sum(monetary_value) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_customer)/sum(monetary_value) AS repeat_spend_share FROM analytics.customer_metrics

segments.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.segment_summary ORDER BY customers DESC

frequency.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.purchase_frequency ORDER BY order_count

intervals.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.interval_summary ORDER BY population

exclusions.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.exclusion_summary ORDER BY eligibility_reason

validation.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.validation_results ORDER BY check_name

cohort_month1.sql: SELECT sum(active_customers) AS active_customers,sum(cohort_size) AS eligible_cohort_customers,sum(active_customers)::numeric/sum(cohort_size) AS activity_rate FROM analytics.cohort_activity WHERE month_index=1 AND is_observable

monthly_orders.sql: SELECT * FROM bi.monthly_orders ORDER BY purchase_month

interval_caveats.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE same_day) AS same_day_intervals,count(*) FILTER (WHERE same_timestamp) AS same_timestamp_intervals FROM analytics.purchase_intervals

cutoff_sensitivity.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.cutoff_sensitivity ORDER BY cutoff

interval_distribution.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.interval_distribution ORDER BY bucket_order
